Solve the following math problem. Make sure to put the answer (and only answer) inside \boxed{}.

At 10 o'clock, a box contains a ball labeled 1. At 10:30, the ball labeled 1 is removed, and balls labeled 2 and 3 are added. At 10:45, balls labeled 2 and 3 are removed, and balls labeled 4, 5, 6, and 7 are added. This pattern continues, with each action occurring at the halfway point between the previous action and 11 o'clock. Each time, one more ball is removed than the previous time, and twice as many balls are added as the previous time. How many balls will be in the box when the clock strikes 11?
